Jhuki jhuki si nazar, beqaraar hai ke nahin?
Daba daba sa sahi, dil mein pyaar hai ke nahin?
couplets.en: Is that lowered gaze restless, and is there love in your heart, however deeply hidden?

lines: Tu apne dil ki jawaan dhadkanon ko gin ke bata
couplets.en: Count the beats of your young heart and tell me.

lines: Tu apne dil ki jawaan dhadkanon ko gin ke bata
Meri tarah tera dil beqaraar hai ke nahin?
couplets.en: Count the beats of your young heart and tell me if it is as restless as mine.

lines: Daba daba sa sahi, dil mein pyaar hai ke nahin?
couplets.en: Is there love in your heart, however well that lowered gaze conceals it?

lines: Teri ummeed pe thukra raha hoon duniya ko
couplets.en: In the hope of you, I am turning the world away.

lines: Teri ummeed pe thukra raha hoon duniya ko
Tujhe bhi apne pe ye aitbaar hai ke nahin?
couplets.en: In the hope of you, I am turning the world away, but do you have that same faith in yourself?

lines: Daba daba sa sahi, dil mein pyaar hai ke nahin?
couplets.en: Is there love in your heart, however well that lowered gaze conceals it?
